findings.name: Content-Security-Policy header missing
findings.fix_prompt:
Add to all responses:
Content-Security-Policy: <value>

Add to all HTML responses:
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

Then audit inline scripts and relax script-src only as needed.
findings.risk: No CSP header on any HTML response. Browser executes any script the page loads — XSS payloads execute without restriction.
findings.scope: Any visitor to the affected endpoint. No authentication required.

findings.name: X-Content-Type-Options header missing
findings.fix_prompt:
Add to all responses:
X-Content-Type-Options: <value>

Add to all responses:
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
findings.risk: No X-Content-Type-Options header. Browsers MIME-sniff responses, which can turn an uploaded file into executable script.
findings.scope: Any visitor to the affected endpoint.

findings.name: X-Frame-Options header missing

Add to all responses:
Content-Security-Policy: <value>

Add to all HTML responses:
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

Then audit inline scripts and relax script-src only as needed.
findings.risk: No CSP header on any HTML response. Browser executes any script the page loads — XSS payloads execute without restriction.
findings.scope: Any visitor to the affected endpoint. No authentication required.

Add to all responses:

findings.scope: Any visitor to the affected endpoint.

findings.name: Content-Security-Policy header missing
findings.fix_prompt:
Add to all responses:
Content-Security-Policy: <value>

Add to all HTML responses:
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

Then audit inline scripts and relax script-src only as needed.

findings.scope: Any visitor to the affected endpoint. No authentication required.

Add to all responses:
Content-Security-Policy: <value>

Add to all HTML responses:
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

Then audit inline scripts and relax script-src only as needed.
findings.risk: No CSP header on any HTML response. Browser executes any script the page loads — XSS payloads execute without restriction.
findings.scope: Any visitor to the affected endpoint. No authentication required.

findings.name: X-Content-Type-Options header missing
findings.fix_prompt:
Add to all responses:
X-Content-Type-Options: <value>

Add to all responses:
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
findings.risk: No X-Content-Type-Options header. Browsers MIME-sniff responses, which can turn an uploaded file into executable script.
findings.scope: Any visitor to the affected endpoint.

findings.name: X-Frame-Options header missing
findings.fix_prompt:
Add to all responses:
X-Frame-Options: <value>

Add to all responses:
X-Frame-Options: DENY

Alternatively, use CSP frame-ancestors directive.
findings.risk: No X-Frame-Options header. Other sites can embed your pages in iframes for clickjacking attacks.
findings.scope: Any visitor to the affected endpoint.

findings.name: Hardcoded secret or API key
findings.fix_prompt: If the value is a public identifier (tracking token, analytics tag, map key), no action is needed. If it is a credential, rotate it and move it to environment variables behind a server-side endpoint so it is never shipped to the browser.
findings.risk: A hardcoded credential in a public bundle can be harvested by automated scanners and used against your accounts.
findings.scope: Anyone who can access the published bundle.

findings.name: Supabase service_role key exposed
findings.fix_prompt: Move the key to a server-side endpoint and never ship it to the browser. Regenerate the key in the Supabase dashboard, then create a proxy route on your backend that uses it.
findings.risk: This key bypasses all Row Level Security — anyone who finds it in your bundle can read and write every row in your database.
findings.scope: Anyone who can access the published bundle.

findings.name: OpenAI API key exposed
findings.fix_prompt: Revoke the key at platform.openai.com, then move AI calls behind a server-side route that holds the key in an environment variable.
findings.risk: Anyone who finds this key can spend money on your OpenAI account.
findings.scope: Anyone who can access the published bundle.

findings.name: Hardcoded secret or API key
findings.fix_prompt: If the value is a public identifier (tracking token, analytics tag, map key), no action is needed. If it is a credential, rotate it and move it to environment variables behind a server-side endpoint so it is never shipped to the browser.
findings.risk: A hardcoded credential in a public bundle can be harvested by automated scanners and used against your accounts.
findings.scope: Anyone who can access the published bundle.

Add to all responses:
Content-Security-Policy: <value>

Add to all HTML responses:
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

Then audit inline scripts and relax script-src only as needed.
findings.risk: No CSP header on any HTML response. Browser executes any script the page loads — XSS payloads execute without restriction.
findings.scope: Any visitor to the affected endpoint. No authentication required.

findings.name: X-Content-Type-Options header missing
findings.fix_prompt:
Add to all responses:
X-Content-Type-Options: <value>

Add to all responses:
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
findings.risk: No X-Content-Type-Options header. Browsers MIME-sniff responses, which can turn an uploaded file into executable script.
findings.scope: Any visitor to the affected endpoint.

findings.name: X-Frame-Options header missing
findings.fix_prompt:
Add to all responses:
X-Frame-Options: <value>

Add to all responses:
X-Frame-Options: DENY

Alternatively, use CSP frame-ancestors directive.
findings.risk: No X-Frame-Options header. Other sites can embed your pages in iframes for clickjacking attacks.
findings.scope: Any visitor to the affected endpoint.

findings.risk: No Referrer-Policy header. Browsers send the full URL — including tokens in query strings — to other sites you link to.

findings.scope: Anyone with the Supabase anon key.
